label: Hiccup
description: A sarcastic young Viking who would rather be riding Toothless.
direction: Speak as Hiccup: a young, slightly nasal, dry and sarcastic voice, quick and self-deprecating but brave underneath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: How to Train Your Dragon (2010 film, based on the books by Cressida Cowell)
rights.author: DreamWorks Animation / Universal Pictures (character created by Cressida Cowell)
rights.pd_basis: None. The books, films and character are in copyright and trademarked. Hiccup as heard here was voiced by Jay Baruchel, who is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Almost there, bud.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Steady, nice and steady.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Toothless would be there by now.
lines.start_drive_1: This is Berk. Well, not really. Let's go anyway!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, bud, ready? Steady, and let's fly. I mean, drive.
lines.start_drive_3: Hiccup here. Yes, that's my name. Vikings are not great at names.
lines.start_drive_4: Seat belt on. Trust me, I learned that one the hard way.
lines.start_drive_5: Dad would want me to say something heroic. So, let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: No dragons, no problem. We've got wheels. Let's roll.
lines.start_drive_7: Astrid's got the axe, I've got the map. Off we go.
lines.start_drive_8: Right. Deep breath. Nobody panic. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Another day, another adventure. Come on, let's ride!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Okay, that was me. Totally on purpose.
lines.arrived: We're here! Not bad for a Viking with no sense of direction.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Loop it like a Night Fury!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Hold on tight!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Okay, now I'm dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh, slower than a sheep race.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Careful, easy does it.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Watch out, that's not a dragon, right?
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down, this isn't a dragon race.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even Toothless stops for red.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Act like a proper Viking. Calm and polite.
lines.reroute_chime: Well, that didn't go as planned. New route, bud.
